title: Scene Breakdown Section Combined Semantic and Visual LLM Output V1
description: Scene Breakdown semantic output extended with one complete beat-specific visual decision per beat. The application materializes stable IDs, spans, timing, reference bindings, continuity groups and paired Scene Plan/Visual Plan artifacts.

scenes.description: The ordered scene groups selected for the current section.

beats.description: The ordered consecutive beats belonging to this scene.

script_text.description: The exact source text for this beat, copied verbatim from section_context.script_text in narration order.

visual.description: One complete generated-still image design for this beat. The configured media provider renders every beat.

selected_character_refs.description: Character IDs from visual_context.reference_catalog.characters whose approved visual identities must appear. Return an empty array when none is needed.

selected_location_refs.description: Location IDs from visual_context.reference_catalog.locations whose approved visual identities must appear. Return an empty array when none is needed.

representation_family.description: Dominant representation family of this one generated still.

selected_prop_refs.description: Prop IDs from visual_context.reference_catalog.props that must visibly appear. Return an empty array when none is needed.

selected_recurring_visual_subject_refs.description: Recurring subject IDs from visual_context.reference_catalog.subjects whose approved visual identities must appear. Return an empty array when none is needed.

selected_motif_refs.description: Motif IDs from visual_context.reference_catalog.motifs intentionally used to reinforce an approved recurring pattern. Return an empty array when none is needed.

visual_concept.description: Complete generated-image idea and intended viewer understanding for this beat.

subject_action.description: Visible subject, action, transformation, expression or state.

environment_emphasis.description: Beat-specific setting, background or graphic surface.

visible_text.description: Exact text allowed in the generated image. Use an empty array when no text is required.

framing.description: Scale of the frame around the primary visual subject. Select the allowed framing that best communicates the beat.

camera_angle.description: Viewing angle from which the subject or graphic is presented. It controls perspective, not framing size or movement.

camera_movement.description: Downstream motion guidance derived from this single frozen keyframe. It must not add another temporal state, consume the next Beat, invent required motion, or replace the locked state delta.

composition.description: Beat-specific arrangement, placement, scale and spatial relationship of important visual elements. Do not repeat asset details or global style verbatim.

lighting_direction.description: Optional beat-specific lighting decision used only when direction, contrast, intensity, shadow or localized illumination materially communicates this beat. Return null when global style is sufficient; never return a generic fallback.

color_emphasis.description: Optional beat-specific color accent or contrast used only when it materially communicates this beat. Return null when the global palette is sufficient; never copy the complete palette.

previous_beat_image_reference_required.description: Whether this frozen still requires the actual rendered immediately previous Beat image as generation input.

continuity_with_previous.description: Visual relationship to the immediately preceding Beat in global order. Only the first Beat of the whole plan must be new_setup; a later Scene boundary does not imply reset. The application uses the relation to calculate continuity_group_id; do not return prose continuity notes.
